GUNFIRE.script: perfect sustained Pulse Laser S fire until kill or timeout

DISPLACEMENT.script: repeat Concussion Cannon M impulse along the target-to-rock line; terrain contact is emitted only after integrated motion reaches the rock

scenario.aiIntentSurface: scripted target intent is present; collisionConsequences control override is measured after the tick slot where tacticalAI normally writes/revalidates firing intent

mechanismNotes.finding: Terrain collision damage is capped at 220 per consequence and only begins above deltaV 5.
Concussion Cannon M supplies 420 momentum per hit: about 26.25 wu/s on the light hull and 7 wu/s on the medium hull before contact response.
Across displacement runs: 40 collision-attributed kills, 0 direct-weapon-attributed kills, 0 survivals.

The headless target does not run the full tacticalAI stack; it exposes the same mutable intent surface and measures collisionConsequences overriding fire/move intent after the tacticalAI slot would normally write or revalidate it.
